label.description: Short label describing the metric, e.g. "Monthly Revenue".

value.description: The statistic. Strings rendered verbatim; numbers formatted via formatNumber.

attention.description: Draws an amber attention dot before the label. Set it only when the value is a non-zero bad count (such as missed runs or items waiting on you), never on a zero or a healthy count. The dot is decorative: the label wording carries the meaning.

caption.description: A short muted line under the value that says what it means in words, such as "Nothing is running", "An approval and a question" or "3 done · 2 waiting on you". It describes the group for assistive technology, so state it as a sentence fragment that stands on its own.

loading.description: Draws a placeholder block where the value goes, for a statistic whose number has not been read yet, so the tile keeps its size when the number arrives. The tile is marked busy, and `value` is not shown or announced while it is set.

theme.description: Partial visual theme override. Omitted fields inherit the surrounding application.

valueLocale.description: Locale forwarded to formatNumber. Defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider locale, then en-US.

style.description: Inline style string applied to the `.cinder-statistic` root.

unsupportedProps.name: change
unsupportedProps.description: Optional change indicator with direction and accessible wording.

unsupportedProps.name: icon
unsupportedProps.description: Optional leading icon snippet (decorative — wrapper is aria-hidden).

unsupportedProps.name: valueFormatOptions
unsupportedProps.description: Intl.NumberFormat options applied only when `value` is a number.
